verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a plain C/C++ runtime with no dependencies, ships as pre-built binaries, and is praised by the community for being dependency-free. Community discussion of the mmap change calls loading-time performance 'a huge win for usability', which supports fast model startup. missing for 10: concrete cold-start or time-to-first-token measurements, first-party documentation of startup or load-time behavior, and binary-size figures.
